subject: Video of a bag being tossed from a second-floor White House window
claim: Asked about the viral video, Trump said it was probably AI-generated, arguing the residence windows are sealed, armored and too heavy to open.
finding: Hours earlier, a White House official had told TIME and other outlets the video showed a contractor doing regular maintenance while the president was away. That implied the footage was real.
outcome: No consequence. The official explanation and the president's contradicted each other on the same day.

sources.title: Trump Says Viral Video Was 'Probably A.I.' After White House Implied Otherwise
Trump calls video of bag thrown out of White House fake. A White House official reportedly suggests otherwise
